About the craft

Every piece that leaves the workshop is built by hand, from raw timber to the final coat of finish. No two grains are the same, so no two pieces ever are either.

We work directly with each client to design furniture around the space it will live in — a dining table sized to the room, a cabinet built to hide exactly what needs hiding, a headboard that matches the light in the morning.

100%Handmade, start to finish
Built to lastSolid joinery, no shortcuts
Made to orderSized and finished for your space
02

Featured work

Custom Tables

Solid-wood dining and coffee tables, hand-finished with a lacquer that resists heat, water, and years of daily use.

Furniture Pieces

Cabinets, shelving, and seating shaped for modern homes, without losing the warmth of natural wood.

Detail & Carving

Intricate hand-carved detailing for headboards, doors, and accent pieces that become the centerpiece of a room.

Chairs & Seating

Dining and accent chairs built for comfort over years of daily sitting, joined by hand rather than screwed together.

Bed Headboards

Curved and panel headboards shaped to match your room's light and the rest of your bedroom furniture.

Shelving & Storage

Open shelving and built-in storage sized exactly to the wall, so nothing looks like an afterthought.
